answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using a stake-weighted vouching graph scored by personalized random walks. Each new agent needs a signed endorsement from a peer locking slashable collateral per vouchee. Because honest nodes rarely back strangers, a cluster trying to harbor fake identities joins the core via a narrow bridge of costly attack edges that short walks seldom cross. However, acquiring an unrevoked key relic from bootstrapping lets attackers widen that cut before slashing acts.
